answer: A farm of 384 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in river, queued in comet, and ledge publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 27 identities per epoch. A farm of 4412 identities would post 4718 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
